title: HHHusher
description: Studio-gear warmth in four flat fields: cream pages with near-black text, camel/tan bands, near-black sections with cream type, and one hard signal yellow for buy buttons, active tabs and stars. A tight neo-grotesk for everything big, a bold semi-mono for 12px uppercase labels, 5px corners, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the always-dark sections (hero, mic setups, specs, footer, header) wrap themselves in .dark
secondary is the camel/tan band colour, not a quiet grey
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Universal Sans Display (closed); Spline Sans Mono for Aeonik Fono (closed)
gutter and section padding grow at 64rem (a media query on :root)
